name: OpenAI Codex CLI
description: Installs the standalone OpenAI Codex CLI globally without requiring Node.js or npm, and optionally links Codex state folders into the workspace.

codexVersion.description: Codex CLI release version to install. Use 'latest' to resolve the newest release at build time.

codexInstallDir.description: Directory where the global codex command symlink is installed.

codexStandaloneHome.description: Directory where standalone Codex release payloads are stored.

codexLinkFolders.description: Optional folder link mappings. Target paths must resolve to absolute container paths. Omit this option when no folder links are needed.
